about.thesisSubtitle: Boilerplate for Data Visualization and Analysis Tools
about.thesisDescription: A Python desktop application for dataset feature analysis, prototyping and testing machine learning and statistical models. Built with a modular architecture using GTK for the UI, featuring a custom state management system with the Observer pattern, a typed JSON ORM with Pydantic and TinyDB, and internationalization support (i18n). Includes Docker containerization and automated documentation with MkDocs.

siteAbout.title: About this site
siteAbout.intro: This is the personal website and portfolio of Zau Julio — a place to share professional work, writing, and the hobbies that keep the balance. This page explains, in plain terms, what the site is, how it was built, and how your privacy is respected here.

sections.heading: What this site is
sections.body: A personal portfolio and digital garden. Alongside professional projects and articles, it collects hobbies — photography, cooking, music, games, books, and film. Nothing here is a commercial product or service; it is a place to show work and share ideas.

sections.heading: Privacy
sections.body: This site does not sell or share your personal data. It collects no accounts, no logins, and no personal information you don't volunteer. Lightweight, privacy-respecting analytics may be used to understand aggregate traffic (such as page views and performance), never to identify you individually. External links (streaming services, stores, social networks) open on third-party sites governed by their own privacy policies.

sections.heading: How AI was used
sections.body: Parts of this site were built with the help of AI coding assistants, used as a tool under human direction and review. AI helped with implementation, refactoring, and drafting — but the ideas, decisions, editorial choices, and final review are the author's own. Where AI generated or assisted content, it was checked and edited by a human. No content here is published unreviewed.

sections.heading: Content and accuracy
sections.body: Opinions, reviews, and notes reflect the author's personal views at the time of writing and may change. Cover images, logos, and trademarks belong to their respective owners and are used for identification and editorial reference only. If you believe something is inaccurate or should be corrected, please get in touch.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For professional inquiries, corrections, or questions about this site, reach out by email at zaujulio.dev@gmail.com. This site is operated by Zau Julio (CNPJ 49.708.916/0001-90).

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.intro: Accessibility is a priority for this site. The goal is that everyone — including people who rely on assistive technology — can navigate, read, and use every page comfortably.

sections.heading: Commitment
sections.body: This site aims to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at level AA. Accessibility is treated as an ongoing effort rather than a one-time task: pages are reviewed and improved over time.

sections.heading: What's in place
sections.body: Semantic HTML and landmarks for screen readers; keyboard navigation for interactive elements; visible focus indicators; descriptive alt text on meaningful images; ARIA labels on icon-only controls; color choices checked for contrast; a responsive layout that reflows without horizontal scrolling; and support for reduced-motion preferences.

sections.heading: Language and structure
sections.body: The site is available in English and Portuguese, with the page language declared for assistive technology. Headings follow a logical order, and content is structured so it can be understood without relying on color or shape alone.

sections.heading: Known limitations
sections.body: Some third-party embeds and external destinations (streaming services, stores) are outside this site's control and may not meet the same standards. Where such content appears, an accessible text alternative or label is provided whenever possible.

sections.heading: Feedback
sections.body: If you encounter an accessibility barrier, or need content in a different format, please email zaujulio.dev@gmail.com with a description of the problem and the page where it occurred. Reports are taken seriously and used to improve the site.
